name: -lm
--load-mode
options.description: Model loading mode (default: auto) - auto: mmap, unless a device does not support it - none: no special loading mode - mmap: memory-map model (if mmap disabled, slower load but may reduce pageouts if not using mlock) - mlock: force system to keep model in RAM rather than swapping or compressing - mmap+mlock: mmap + force system to keep model in RAM rather than swapping or compressing - dio: use DirectIO if available

name: -lzm
--lazy-mode
options.description: On-demand reading of certain tensors, for example per-layer embeddings (default: auto) - on: read the rows of such tensors from disk on demand instead of keeping them resident (requires mmap) - auto: on, but only for tensors larger than 4 GiB - off: always keep them resident

options.name: --numa
options.description: Attempt optimizations that help on some NUMA systems - distribute: spread execution evenly over all nodes - isolate: only spawn threads on CPUs on the node that execution started on - numactl: use the CPU map provided by numactl if run without this previously, it is recommended to drop the system page cache before using this see https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/issues/1437

name: --cors-credentials
--no-cors-credentials
options.description: Whether to allow credentials for CORS (default: enabled) note: if this is enabled and --cors-origins is set to * (default), the Origin header will be echoed back, and credentials will always be allowed

options.name: --api-prefix
options.description: Prefix path the server serves from, without the trailing slash (default: )

name: --ui-config
--webui-config
options.description: JSON that provides default UI settings (overrides UI defaults)

name: --ui-config-file
--webui-config-file
options.description: JSON file that provides default UI settings (overrides UI defaults)

name: --ui-mcp-proxy
--webui-mcp-proxy
--no-ui-mcp-proxy
--no-webui-mcp-proxy
options.description: Experimental: whether to enable MCP CORS proxy - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: disabled)

options.name: --tools
options.description: Experimental: whether to enable built-in tools for AI agents - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: no tools) specify "all" to enable all tools available tools: read_file, file_glob_search, grep_search, exec_shell_command, write_file, edit_file, get_info note: for security reasons, this will limit --cors-origins to localhost by default

options.name: --tools-runtime
options.description: Experimental: run tools in a separate runtime environment (default: none, use host environment) available options: 'docker:<image>', 'podman:<image>': spin up a new container and reuse it for all invocations, clean up on server exit 'docker-container:<id>', 'podman-container:<id>': use an existing container by ID, won't stop on server exit 'ssh:<target>': run tools on a remote POSIX host over SSH, key-based auth and a trusted host key are required

options.name: --mcp-servers-config
options.description: Experimental: path to JSON file with MCP server definitions (Cursor-compatible format) - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: none) note: for security reasons, this will limit --cors-origins to localhost by default

options.name: --mcp-servers-json
options.description: Experimental: inline JSON with MCP server definitions (Cursor-compatible format) - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: none) note: for security reasons, this will limit --cors-origins to localhost by default

name: -ag
--agent
-no-ag
--no-agent
options.description: Whether to enable CORS proxy and all built-in tools - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: disabled) note: for security reasons, this will limit --cors-origins to localhost by default

name: --ui
--webui
--no-ui
--no-webui
options.description: Whether to enable the Web UI (default: enabled)

name: --embedding
--embeddings
options.description: Restrict to only support embedding use case

name: --rerank
--reranking
options.description: Enable reranking endpoint on server (default: disabled)

options.name: --api-key
options.description: API key to use for authentication, multiple keys can be provided as a comma-separated list (default: none)

options.name: --api-key-file
options.description: Path to file containing API keys, one per line

options.name: --ssl-key-file
options.description: Path to file a PEM-encoded SSL private key

options.name: --ssl-cert-file
options.description: Path to file a PEM-encoded SSL certificate

options.name: --chat-template-kwargs
options.description: Sets additional params for the json template parser, must be a valid json object string, e.g. '{"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"}'

name: -to
--timeout
options.description: Server read/write timeout in seconds (default: 3600)

options.name: --sse-ping-interval
options.description: Server SSE ping interval in seconds (-1 = disabled, default: 30)

options.name: --threads-http
options.description: Number of threads used to process HTTP requests (default: -1)

name: --cache-prompt
--no-cache-prompt
options.description: Whether to enable prompt caching (default: enabled)

options.name: --cache-reuse
options.description: Min chunk size to attempt reusing from the cache via KV shifting, requires prompt caching to be enabled (default: 0) [(card)](https://ggml.ai/f0.png)

options.name: --metrics
options.description: Enable prometheus compatible metrics endpoint (default: disabled)

options.name: --props
options.description: Enable changing global properties via POST /props (default: disabled)

name: --slots
--no-slots
options.description: Expose slots monitoring endpoint (default: enabled)

options.name: --slot-save-path
options.description: Path to save slot kv cache (default: disabled)

options.name: --media-path
options.description: Directory for loading local media files

options.name: --models-dir
options.description: Directory containing models for the router server (default: disabled)

options.name: --models-preset
options.description: Path to INI file containing model presets for the router server (default: disabled)

options.name: --models-max
options.description: For router server, maximum number of models to load simultaneously (default: 4, 0 = unlimited)

name: --models-autoload
--no-models-autoload
options.description: For router server, whether to automatically load models (default: enabled)

name: --jinja
--no-jinja
options.description: Whether to use jinja template engine for chat (default: enabled)

options.name: --reasoning-format
options.description: Controls whether thought tags are allowed and/or extracted from the response, and in which format they're returned

name: -rea
--reasoning
options.description: Use reasoning/thinking in the chat ('on', 'off', or 'auto', default: 'auto' (detect from template))

options.name: --reasoning-effort
options.description: Reasoning effort level given to the chat template: 'default' to keep the template default, or a level such as 'minimal', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh' or 'max' (default: default)

options.name: --reasoning-budget
options.description: Token budget for thinking: -1 for unrestricted, 0 for immediate end, N>0 for token budget (default: -1)

options.name: --reasoning-budget-message
options.description: Message injected before the end-of-thinking tag when reasoning budget is exhausted (default: none)

name: --reasoning-preserve
--no-reasoning-preserve
options.description: Preserve reasoning trace in the full history, not just the last assistant message (default: enabled) compatible with certain templates having 'supports_preserve_reasoning' capability example: https://docs.z.ai/guides/capabilities/thinking-mode#preserved-thinking

options.name: --chat-template
options.description: Set custom jinja chat template (default: template taken from model's metadata) if suffix/prefix are specified, template will be disabled only commonly used templates are accepted (unless --jinja is set before this flag): list of built-in templates: bailing, bailing-think, bailing2, chatglm3, chatglm4, chatml, command-r, deepseek, deepseek-ocr, deepseek2, deepseek3, exaone-moe, exaone3, exaone4, falcon3, gemma, gigachat, glmedge, gpt-oss, granite, granite-4.0, granite-4.1, grok-2, hunyuan-dense, hunyuan-moe, hunyuan-vl, kimi-k2, llama2, llama2-sys, llama2-sys-bos, llama2-sys-strip, llama3, llama4, megrez, minicpm, mistral-v1, mistral-v3, mistral-v3-tekken, mistral-v7, mistral-v7-tekken, monarch, openchat, orion, pangu-embedded, phi3, phi4, rwkv-world, seed_oss, smolvlm, solar-open, vicuna, vicuna-orca, yandex, zephyr

options.name: --chat-template-file
options.description: Set custom jinja chat template file (default: template taken from model's metadata) if suffix/prefix are specified, template will be disabled only commonly used templates are accepted (unless --jinja is set before this flag): list of built-in templates: bailing, bailing-think, bailing2, chatglm3, chatglm4, chatml, command-r, deepseek, deepseek-ocr, deepseek2, deepseek3, exaone-moe, exaone3, exaone4, falcon3, gemma, gigachat, glmedge, gpt-oss, granite, granite-4.0, granite-4.1, grok-2, hunyuan-dense, hunyuan-moe, hunyuan-vl, kimi-k2, llama2, llama2-sys, llama2-sys-bos, llama2-sys-strip, llama3, llama4, megrez, minicpm, mistral-v1, mistral-v3, mistral-v3-tekken, mistral-v7, mistral-v7-tekken, monarch, openchat, orion, pangu-embedded, phi3, phi4, rwkv-world, seed_oss, smolvlm, solar-open, vicuna, vicuna-orca, yandex, zephyr

name: --skip-chat-parsing
--no-skip-chat-parsing
options.description: Force a pure content parser, even if a Jinja template is specified

name: --prefill-assistant
--no-prefill-assistant
options.description: Whether to prefill the assistant's response if the last message is an assistant message (default: prefill enabled) when this flag is set, if the last message is an assistant message then it will be treated as a full message and not prefilled

name: -sps
--slot-prompt-similarity
options.description: How much the prompt of a request must match the prompt of a slot in order to use that slot (default: 0.10, 0.0 = disabled)

options.name: --lora-init-without-apply
options.description: Load LoRA adapters without applying them (apply later via POST /lora-adapters) (default: disabled)

options.name: --sleep-idle-seconds
options.description: Number of seconds of idleness after which the server will sleep (default: -1

options.name: --log-prompts-dir
options.description: Log prompts to directory (auto-created if not present
